entries.f031858648c90005: The company's mission is to drive technological innovation as a connector manufacturer, and to contribute to the development of the electronics industry by developing and providing products that meet diversifying needs. Under its Medium-Term Management Plan "G-WING," the company plans to form three strong pillars of consumer, industrial equipment, and automotive, and to grow sales over the medium to long term while maintaining a high-profit structure. As a medium-term management target, the company aims to achieve consolidated revenue of ¥290 billion in fiscal 2029.
entries.f229db6ac7644538: The company acquired an additional 25% of the shares of Hirose Korea Co., Ltd., bringing its holding to 75% and making it a consolidated subsidiary. It subsequently acquired additional shares, bringing its holding to 100% in January 2015.
entries.f4174ad6fafeedcc: This is the core business of the Group, manufacturing and selling round and rectangular connectors mounted on the outside of equipment, and ribbon cable connectors, printed circuit board connectors, FPC (flexible printed circuit) connectors and nylon connectors mounted inside equipment. They are widely used, from smartphones, communication equipment and car electronics to industrial equipment such as measurement and control instruments, FA equipment and medical devices. In Japan, Tohoku Hirose Denki, Koriyama Hirose Denki and Ichinoseki Hirose Denki handle manufacturing, and overseas, subsidiaries in South Korea, China, Taiwan, Malaysia and Indonesia handle manufacturing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥185,814 million, accounting for most of consolidated revenue.
